name: Weekly Report
tagline: A Monday-morning digest of last week — meetings, email, and every action item you committed to, traced to its source.
who: Leaders and investors whose week is back-to-back meetings — anyone who wants Monday to start with what happened, what they promised, and what needs them, without rereading anything.
how: Every Monday (or on request) your agent sweeps the week's meeting notes, email, and calendar, and delivers a one-page report doc — top of mind, this week's meetings, a deduped action-item list, next week's prep — plus a two-line chat summary. Missing a source? It works with what it has and flags the gap once.
changelog: Reads the context doc first; adds the accountability footer.
